title: Tracking real-space quantum state breathing through Floquet-projector geometry
summary: Periodic driving of spatially periodic quantum systems generates band structures that are absent in static crystals. We present a quantum geometric theory to characterize the Floquet-Bloch states at stroboscopic times and during micromotion on equal footing. Our framework builds upon time-evolved Floquet projectors that connect static quantum geometry, micromotion-operator geometry, and Floquet topology.
